title: Access review
description: Flags a location for review when its straight-line proxy travel time to a qualifying facility exceeds a threshold, and bands every location into a travel-time zone.
mustNotBeReadAs: A clinical recommendation, or a routed travel time. The minutes are a straight-line proxy at a stated walking speed.
rules:
# Proxy access review; not a clinical recommendation or routed travel time.
{ ?p fw:accessKnown false. } => { ?p fw:decision fw:Unknown; fw:zone fw:Unknown. }.
{ ?p fw:proxyMinutes ?m. ?m math:greaterThan {{threshold}}. } => { ?p fw:decision fw:Review. }.
{ ?p fw:proxyMinutes ?m. ?m math:notGreaterThan {{threshold}}. } => { ?p fw:decision fw:NoFlag. }.
{ ?p fw:proxyMinutes ?m. ?m math:notGreaterThan 5. } => { ?p fw:zone fw:Within5. }.
{ ?p fw:proxyMinutes ?m. ?m math:greaterThan 5; math:notGreaterThan 15. } => { ?p fw:zone fw:Within15. }.
{ ?p fw:proxyMinutes ?m. ?m math:greaterThan 15; math:notGreaterThan 30. } => { ?p fw:zone fw:Within30. }.
{ ?p fw:proxyMinutes ?m. ?m math:greaterThan 30. } => { ?p fw:zone fw:Over30. }.

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.meaning: Proxy travel time above which a location is flagged for review.

outputVocabulary.note: Two predicates from one ruleset, and one rule concludes both. This is why a rule form with a single conclusion was refuted by the rulesets that exist.

basis.statedBy: The ruleset text itself: "not a clinical recommendation or routed travel time."
basis.note: The 5, 15 and 30 minute zone bounds are literals in the rules and not parameters, deliberately: they are this rulesets own banding, not a practitioner knob. They are also uncited.
